notes.title: Playtest Update
notes.content: [p]Ready to try out the new and improved features ?[/p][list][*][p]Two biomes: Island 🏝️ and Mountain 🗻[/p][/*][*][p]4 maps per biome[/p][/*][*][p]Longer cooldown for bomb placement [/p][/*][*][p]Love potion becomes visually a magnet (same effect)[/p][/*][*][p]Crossbow is no longer a pickaxe 😁[/p][/*][*][p]New obstacles: teleport, tornado, bouncy mushroom, destructible cloud, powdery snow ,.. and slippery ice surfaces designed to drive you crazy (and make you laugh just as much as we did) 🧊[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][/*][/list]
